exposure: Care setting for 35-weeks' gestation infants (Level II NICU vs. Mother-Baby unit)
outcome: Medical therapies received (caffeine, antibiotics, blood culture, phototherapy, NGT)
Exclusive mother's breast milk (MBM) feeding at discharge
cohort: The study participants were 591 infants born at 35-weeks' gestation at two hospitals within the Duke University Health System between 2014 and 2019.
finding: Admitting 35-weeks' gestation infants directly to the NICU increased medical interventions and length of stay but might reduce hospital readmissions.
